_doc: Mayzing storefront garment categories, captured from each store's category filter page (tshirt, hoodie, sweatshirt, tank_top, crop_tops) by src/scrape_mayzing_apparel.py. Per collection, per design slug, per category: the listings that design genuinely has, with the garment label the store itself uses, the signed w:500 mockup and the exact checkout URL. src/build.py turns this into the team pages' apparel filter buttons. No prices are stored here on purpose - the storefront quotes USD or NOK depending on session geo. Regenerated by the refresh workflow; do not hand-edit.
